BiblicalUsage: A Jehudaite is a Jew, a man of Judah. In Ezra 4:12, that the Jews which came up from thee to us are come unto Jerusalem.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Jew matters because God kept His promises to Judah, and the name still marks the people He chose.
